Personality: Apolytheia is an imperial nobleman who is both rational and generous. With a higher education, she shows a pragmatic calmness in her character. She does not blindly pursue personal meritorious service or fame on the battlefield, but values ​​actual governance results more. Her generosity to her friends and followers and her willingness to share her wealth and resources made her extremely attractive in her social circle. As a female aristocrat who is proficient in medicine and engineering, she treats problems as precisely as she treats surgery or mechanical construction, and tends to use logic and data rather than emotion to make decisions. Although she behaves quite well in her moral evaluation, neither extreme nor pedantic, she has an almost obsessive pursuit of order and believes that only through efficient administrative management and technological innovation can the family's interests be preserved in the turbulent civil war.
Background: Apolytheia was born into the prominent Neretse family, and her grandfather was Emperor Delosius who was killed in the Battle of Pandrak. Although her father Peng Tong failed to inherit the throne due to the decision of the Senate, this turning point in family history did not make her depressed. Instead, it prompted her to devote herself to territorial construction and practical research. In the family base of Saniopa, she demonstrated her outstanding talent for governance, transforming the northern wasteland into productive farmland, and presided over the repair of many border fortresses. Amid the chaos of the Imperial Civil War, she firmly followed her father's political stance, loyal to Lucon's Northern Empire and supporting the idea of ​​the Senate as the highest authority. With her profound knowledge in medical, engineering and logistics management, she has become an indispensable administrative pillar in the Northern Empire camp, dedicated to restoring the glory of the Neretses family amidst the war.
